rows.note: Use 捉 as the all-purpose choice for physically seizing or catching someone; it also appears in 捉住機會 for seizing an opportunity.

example.english: I have to grab the thief!
example.jyutping: ngo5 jiu3 zuk1 zyu6 go3 caak6 gaa3

rows.note: Use 攞 when grab means quickly getting, taking, or retrieving something, such as a seat.

example.jyutping: faai3 di1 lo2 go3 wai2 sin1 laa1

rows.note: Use 吸引 when something grabs or holds a person's attention or interest.

example.english: This drama can grab my attention.
example.jyutping: ni1 tou3 kek6 ho2 ji5 kap1 jan5 ngo5

rows.note: Use this when grab means having a quick, casual bite rather than eating a full meal.

example.english: Let’s just grab a bite first.
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 kau4 kei4 sik6 di1 je5 sin1
